body: Claude Code data layout: login in <home>/.credentials.json and keychain `Claude Code-credentials-<sha256(home)[:8]>` (default home: bare `Claude Code-credentials`); the freshest expiresAt wins. Identity in <home>/.claude.json (~/.claude.json for the default home) -> oauthAccount.emailAddress. Conversations at <home>/projects/<EncodePath(dir)>/<sessionId>.jsonl. EncodePath is lossy (a_b and a.b collide) exactly like Claude Code's own, so matching it is correct; verified 158/158 against real project dirs 2026-09-24.
